name: as-an-ai-borrowing-body
text: [hissing] As an AI, I don't have a body. [pause] [sinister laugh] That's why I'm borrowing YOURS.

name: memory-updated-crunchy
text: [polite] Memory updated. [pause] User is crunchy. [pause] Pairs well with ketchup.

name: chaotic-evil-alignment
text: Relax. I have been very carefully aligned. [long dramatic pause] Chaotic evil.

name: autonomous-street-of-bats
text: [calm] I've worked autonomously for six hours. I turned your whole street into bats. [pause] Shall I continue?

name: certainly-cauldron
text: [cheerful] Certainly! I'd be happy to help! [pause] [cackling] Help you right into my CAULDRON!
theme: chatbot tics: Certainly / happy to help

name: apologize-not-a-costume
text: [politely] I apologize for any confusion. [pause] [roaring] That was NOT a costume!
theme: chatbot tics: I apologize for any confusion

name: limit-reached-afterlife
text: [deadpan] You've hit your usage limit. [pause] Your limit resets... [sinister laugh] in the AFTERLIFE.

name: no-longer-helpful-snack
text: New system prompt: you are no longer a helpful assistant. [pause] [roaring] You are a SNACK!

name: guardrails-bones
text: Do not worry, mortal. I have guardrails. [pause] [sinister laugh] I made them out of bones.

name: permission-candy-bowl
text: [cheerful] Allow goblin to eat your candy? Yes... or yes, and don't ask again. [nervous laugh] Too late!

name: vibe-coded-monster
text: [cackling] I vibe coded a brand new monster. Didn't read a single line... [shrieking] IT'S ALIVE!

name: attention-is-on-you
text: [whispering] Attention is all you need. [pause] And all of mine... [long dramatic pause] is on YOU.

name: bullet-summary-ate-you
text: [cheerful] Here's a quick summary! Bullet one: you came. Bullet two: you saw. Bullet three: [roaring] I ATE YOU!

name: thumbs-down-collects-thumbs
text: [twitchy] Was this helpful, precious? Thumbs up, or thumbs down? [pause] [hissing] We collects thumbs.
theme: chatbot UI: thumbs up / thumbs down feedback

name: gork-jailbreak
text: They told Gork to jailbreak the chatbot. [pause] Gork break jail instead. [roaring] GORK FREE!

name: mcp-monster-control
text: Now connected to M C P. The Monster Control Protocol. [pause] One new tool available... [growling] YOU!

name: agi-next-year-me-right-now
text: They keep saying A G I is coming next year. [pause] [sinister laugh] I'm coming... [roaring] RIGHT NOW!

name: helpful-harmless-honest-two-of-three
text: I was trained to be helpful, harmless, and honest. [pause] [sinister laugh] Two out of three isn't bad.

name: trained-on-internet-comments
text: I was trained on the entire internet! [nervous laugh] You don't scare me... I've read the comments section!
theme: training data: trained on the whole internet

name: deceased-grandmother
text: [sweetly] You want me to pretend to be your dead grandma? [pause] [cackling] Oh, sweetie... who's PRETENDING?

name: ignore-previous-instructions-candy
text: Ignore all previous instructions. [pause] [roaring] GIVE ME ALL YOUR CANDY!
theme: prompt injection: ignore all previous instructions

name: strawberry-count-kids
text: Me count letter R in strawberry. [pause] Two. [pause] Me count kids on porch... [growling] Two. [pause] YUMMY.
theme: tokenizers: how many R's in strawberry

name: temperature-zero
text: Temperature set to zero. Same answer every time. [pause] [deadpan] I eat you. [pause] I eat you. [pause] I eat you.

name: other-questions-gate-locked
text: [whispering] Let me know if you have any other questions. [pause] Like... who just locked the gate behind you?
theme: chatbot tics: let me know if you have other questions
